column1: # What each capability needs and which inventory row proves it in each privilege tier.
#   needs  none  any workload can use it: the unprivileged session must be PASS (or LIMIT)
#          root  only real root can: the unprivileged session must be DENIED by a deny: row (never reported as working),
#                the privileged session PASS or LIMIT, or the guest PASS where the host must not be made to do it
#          host  the host kernel or hardware must provide it: the privileged session must be PASS or LIMIT (a LIMIT
#                names what the host lacks in limits.tsv); the unprivileged cell is never a deny: row that passes
#   guest  a PASSing row of the test bed guest (cgroup v2 kernel with the features the host lacks), or '-'
# Every deny: row of the inventory must be referenced here: a refusal is only evidence when a capability depends on it.
